description: Colgate-Palmolive (Pakistan) Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing, import, export and selling consumer products such as oral care products, personal care products, detergents, household cleaning products and other related goods. It was registered on 5 December 1977. On its own site the brand range is organised into oral care, personal care hair, personal care skin, fabric care and surface care.
headOffice: Lakson Square Building No. 2, Sarwar Shaheed Road, Karachi, Pakistan
